question: Which plants (amino-acid, yeast, brewing, vaccine) train their own fermentation operators, how long does it take, and would any open trainee places or tank time to outsiders, at what fee?
why_it_matters: Hands-on operator training needs pilot-scale kit that Vietnam lacks until RM-04 (by 2030); tolling hosts are the only domestic route before then. Decides whether RM-09 can start in 2027 with hands-on content
cheapest_way_to_close: Phone the training or HR managers of three plants (Vedan, Ajinomoto, one brewery); ask FIRI's fermentation department

question: Did any university submit or win a MOET talent programme under Decision 1002 in biotechnology plus food or bioprocess engineering ('CNSH+X'), and with how much state lab investment?
why_it_matters: Names the vehicle and host for the senior-engineer half of RM-09 and could co-fund pilot kit
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask MOET's Higher Education Department; read MOET decisions approving talent programmes (2025 and 2026 cycles)
owner_org_to_ask: MOET (Higher Education Department); HUST; IUH; Can Tho University

question: Is the intermediate-level fermentation technician programme (Circular 17/2013/TT-BGDĐT) still in force, and which colleges teach it, with what intake?
why_it_matters: Operators are the gap a pilot or first plant hits; RM-09 names no vocational actor
cheapest_way_to_close: Read the circular on thuvienphapluat.vn; ask MOIT's Department of Organisation and Personnel or the Food Industry College (Viet Tri)

question: Could NAFOSTED run a thematic or directed call on protein from Vietnamese side streams and species under Law 93/2025, and would it accept co-funding from a foreign foundation?
why_it_matters: A first call of about VND 9 to 10 billion (USD 0.35 million) would test RM-11 at a scale Vietnam already funds; co-funding would bring in international money that has never reached Vietnam (0 of 270 GFI-funded works)
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask NAFOSTED's planning department; read the implementing decree on S&T funds under Law 93/2025

question: Would Thai or Singapore pilot facilities (for example EECi, BIOTEC or a Singapore polytechnic) accept Vietnamese trainees for hands-on fermentation or extrusion training, and at what cost per trainee?
why_it_matters: An interim route for RM-09's hands-on part before Vietnam has its own pilot line
cheapest_way_to_close: Email the training offices of EECi or BIOTEC (Thailand) and Nanyang Polytechnic or the Singapore Institute of Technology

question: Has VINIF opened any research or scholarship call since its December 2024 programme announcement, and does it fund food or biotechnology?
why_it_matters: VINIF was the second domestic funder named in chapter 6; its 2025 to 2026 status is unknown
cheapest_way_to_close: Read the VINIF news page in Vietnamese or ask VINIF
